import { MeshBasicNodeMaterial, PlaneGeometry } from 'three/webgpu';
import { vec3, mix, uv } from 'three/tsl';
import { gsap } from 'gsap';

export default function createNode(config, ctx) {
  const { Group, Mesh, Color } = ctx.THREE;
  const mainGroup = new Group();

  const colors = config.colors ?? config.intent?.visualSpec?.colors ?? {
    ink: '#16161d',
    paper: '#e8ecf2',
    accent: '#ff2a38',
    surface: '#0b0b10'
  };

  // 1. BACKDROP: Engineered vertical gradient plane
  const width = 2.4;
  const height = 0.8;
  const backdropGeom = new PlaneGeometry(width, height);

  const cTop = new Color(colors.ink);
  const cBottom = new Color(colors.surface);

  const gradientNode = mix(
    vec3(cBottom.r, cBottom.g, cBottom.b),
    vec3(cTop.r, cTop.g, cTop.b),
    uv().y
  );

  const backdropMat = new MeshBasicNodeMaterial({
    transparent: true,
    opacity: 0.95
  });
  backdropMat.colorNode = gradientNode;

  const backdropMesh = new Mesh(backdropGeom, backdropMat);
  mainGroup.add(backdropMesh);

  // Accent Edge Line (Signal Red accent representing engineered precision)
  const accentGeom = new PlaneGeometry(0.04, height);
  const accentMat = new MeshBasicNodeMaterial({
    color: new Color(colors.accent)
  });
  const accentMesh = new Mesh(accentGeom, accentMat);
  accentMesh.position.set(-width / 2 + 0.02, 0, 0.01);
  mainGroup.add(accentMesh);

  // 2. TEXT CONTENT
  const items = config.textContent ?? config.intent?.visualSpec?.textContent ?? [];
  let displayText = "Pricing 3";
  if (items.length > 0) {
    displayText = items[0].text || displayText;
  }

  // Create text via MSDF Font Atlas
  const textObj = ctx.fontAtlas.createText(displayText, {
    fontSize: 0.14,
    color: colors.paper,
    align: 'left'
  });
  textObj.position.set(-width / 2 + 0.16, -0.05, 0.02);
  mainGroup.add(textObj);

  // 3. IMAGE ASSET LOAD (Decorative Sub-plane)
  let imageMesh = null;
  let imgGeom = null;
  let imgMat = null;
  let loadedTexture = null;

  const imageUrl = config.imageUrl || (config.intent?.visualSpec?.assets && config.intent.visualSpec.assets[0]?.url);
  if (imageUrl) {
    imgGeom = new PlaneGeometry(0.5, 0.5);
    imgMat = new MeshBasicNodeMaterial({
      transparent: true,
      opacity: 0.82,
      depthWrite: false
    });
    imageMesh = new Mesh(imgGeom, imgMat);
    imageMesh.position.set(width / 2 - 0.4, 0, 0.02);
    mainGroup.add(imageMesh);

    ctx.textureLoader.loadTexture(imageUrl).then((tex) => {
      if (tex) {
        loadedTexture = tex;
        imgMat.map = tex;
        imgMat.needsUpdate = true;
      }
    }).catch((err) => {
      console.warn("Failed loading decorative asset:", err);
    });
  }

  // 4. MOTION ENTRANCE
  mainGroup.scale.set(0.01, 0.01, 0.01);
  const enterTl = gsap.timeline();
  enterTl.to(mainGroup.scale, {
    x: 1,
    y: 1,
    z: 1,
    duration: 0.8,
    ease: "power4.out"
  });

  // 5. UNIFIED CLEANUP FOR RESOURCE DISPOSAL
  const cleanup = () => {
    if (enterTl) {
      enterTl.kill();
    }
    backdropGeom.dispose();
    backdropMat.dispose();
    accentGeom.dispose();
    accentMat.dispose();
    if (imgGeom) {
      imgGeom.dispose();
    }
    if (imgMat) {
      imgMat.dispose();
    }
    if (loadedTexture) {
      loadedTexture.dispose();
    }
  };

  mainGroup.userData = {
    cleanup: cleanup
  };

  return mainGroup;
}
